name: Spline-based Deformation Field
definition: A deformation field parametrization using cubic B-splines with time-modulated weights to map spatial coordinates $(x, y, z)$ at time $t$ to canonical coordinates $(x_0, y_0, z_0)$, enabling reconstruction from sparse projections.
summary: Spline-based Deformation Field maps dynamic volume coordinates to a canonical space using cubic B-splines, enabling reconstruction from as few as two projections unlike neural deformation fields.
